hypotheses.title: Operating Margin Inflection Velocity
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Operating profitability per dollar of revenue measures a firm's operational leverage and cost discipline. While static operating margins are largely incorporated into consensus analyst targets, the 60-day rate-of-change of operating margin (operating_income / annualized sales) normalized by its 120-day rolling z-score captures fundamental inflection points before they are fully recognized by equity markets. Cross-sectionally ranking within subindustry isolates pure operational acceleration with zero correlation to price-volume momentum.
confounders: Highly cyclical manufacturing companies with volatile seasonal inventory adjustments
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if operating margin velocity fails to achieve Sharpe > 1.25 in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: 120-day rolling z-score of 60-day change in quarterly operating margin, ranked within subindustry.

hypotheses.title: Parkinson Realized Volatility Variance Risk Premium Ratio
hypotheses.economic_rationale: The Parkinson high-low estimator incorporates intraday price paths, providing substantially higher statistical efficiency than close-to-close volatility metrics. When 20-day implied volatility (implied_volatility_mean_20) drastically exceeds 20-day Parkinson realized volatility, options sellers collect an elevated variance risk premium. Option market makers hedging short positions maintain structural long delta inventory. Min-max scaling this volatility ratio over 40 days and ranking within subindustry harvests this structural premium with low turnover.
confounders: Sudden corporate takeovers or earnings announcements where implied volatility correctly prices jump risk
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if Parkinson VRP ratio fails to achieve Sharpe > 1.25 across liquid US equities.

candidates.rationale: 40-day min-max scale of 20-day implied volatility divided by 20-day Parkinson realized volatility, ranked within subindustry.

hypotheses.title: Calibrated Style Surface GARP Multi-Factor Decoupling
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In Batch 274, the non-linear interaction of fscore_growth and fscore_value demonstrated robust predictive power (Sharpe 1.35, Sub-universe Sharpe 0.99) but suffered from sluggish return velocity (Fitness 0.74 due to 120-day lookback). Calibrating the lookback window to 40 days and adding an agile 20-day acceleration component (ts_scale of ts_delta) preserves the core GARP mispricing edge while significantly accelerating capital rotation and annualized returns, driving Fitness to target levels (>= 1.50).
confounders: Firms in secular decline that appear temporarily cheap during transient quarterly revenue bounces
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if calibrated GARP formulation fails to achieve Fitness > 1.40 or Sharpe > 1.30.

candidates.rationale: 40-day rolling z-score of backfilled GARP interaction combined with 40-day min-max scaled 20-day GARP delta, ranked within subindustry.
